_held_T-32916.survey: original survey 20 May 1912; subdivision survey executed by GE Ernesto L. Velante on 15 Dec 1976 (printed '1876')
_held_T-32916.hold_reason: printed description (doc 265 p.2, 19 courses, re-read at 300 dpi; doc 286 is the same RD print run, Ref 2025000121, so not independent) misses closure by 10.11 m (almost due east) and computes 14,234 vs 14,416 sq m (-1.26%). Corners 1-11 are corroborated: corner 11 computed from this title's tie lands 0.04 m from corner 5 of T-52202 (Lot 2-X-4-D) computed from that title's own independent tie, so the error is in courses 11-12 through 19-1. ring_tools' only candidate is course 17-18 S15-06E -> S15-06W (closure 0.91 m, area -0.65%), but the scan clearly prints 'E' and no other certified title in hand prints that course (it is shared with Lot 2-X-3, whose title is not in this batch); the exact fix would be S14-45W 19.10 m, which does not match any single-glyph misread. Needs the T-for Lot 2-X-3 title or the (LRC) Psd-256008 lot data computation. Corner 1 can be placed from the tie alone.
_held_T-32916.note: earlier 47.8% failure was on sub-lot work; the Psd-05-017527 sub-lots in this batch (T-52202, T-52537, T-52538) all close and agree with each other and with T-32916 corners 1-11.
